flags.detail: 'Private states' / 'Markov blanket sees everything' is interpretive language mapped onto a cohomology-dimension-counting fact (H^1 of the adjoint representation restricted to the boundary torus); the math is sound but the physics/cognitive-science vocabulary is metaphorical, not measured.

'Self-naming', 'quine', 'voice is a self-name' is narrative framing over a straightforward census-uniqueness search (does any other 1-cusped manifold share m004's volume and cusp shape); the uniqueness result itself is a real, exact computation but the self-referential/cognitive language is metaphor, not physics.

the 2.5% (6/238) non-genericity statistic is explicitly self-scoped by the author as p~0.025, not significant on its own, and dependent on an admittedly crude comparison class (small-integer 4x4 matrices) -- a reader could over-read this as evidence of design.

the retracted headline itself is a textbook example: a printed f-string of hardcoded arithmetic was presented as a computed Lie-rank descent result. This is flagged and fixed within the same arc, but demonstrates the pattern the seat should watch for elsewhere.

'compact su(3)+su(3), dim 16, is exactly Baez-Schwahn's Stab(B)_0' and 'B8068's cell30 already found (16,16) inside f4 at 9 of 9555 charge directions' are flagged by the author as 'three routes now point at the same 16-dimensional object' -- a dimension/type match across three separate computations that the arc itself does not claim is an identity, but which a reader should treat as a coincidence-of-type flag pending an explicit isomorphism/conjugacy check (the B8068 subalgebra cell shows exactly this kind of match can be isomorphic-but-not-conjugate).

the Poisson-density model's two rho values are each calibrated from a single or pair of recorded hit-counts from other arcs (a fit, not a derivation from first principles); the arc is candid about this and supplies out-of-sample controls (C1-C4), but the underlying SM central values used for the informativeness sweep are hardcoded literals with no citation trail in the script.
